justification: In `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/FilenameUtils.java` the class is 1,728 LOC and exposes 33 public static methods plus 18 private/package helpers. The methods span multiple distinct concerns: path concatenation/normalization (`concat`, `normalize*`, `doNormalize`), prefix/path parsing (`getPrefix*`, `getPath*`, `indexOfLastSeparator`), extension handling (`getExtension`, `removeExtension`, `isExtension`), separator conversion (`separatorsTo*`), and wildcard matching (`wildcardMatch*`, `splitOnTokens`). This breadth and size indicate insufficient modularization.
